uca_sentences: A woman in red was playing with her mobile phone behind the counter, when a man in black with a mask came over.
The man in black put the bag on the table and threatened the woman with a gun.
The woman opened the checkout counter and put money in her bag under threat
The woman turned around to pack her things and put them in her bag
The man in black tidied up and left, while the woman squatted with her hands above her head.
The woman straightened up and quickly left the scene after checking

witness_A.viewpoint: close by, inside, a few metres away
witness_A.statement: A woman behind the counter was being robbed. She put money in a bag, squatted with her hands above her head, and left the scene. I think she was wearing red clothes. The robber left, maybe wearing a mask, and put the bag on the table. The robber held a weapon, but I'm not sure what it was.

witness_B.viewpoint: far away, looking in from outside
witness_B.statement: I saw a woman behind the counter, who opened the checkout counter and squatted with her hands above her head. I think she was playing with her mobile phone. The robber, wearing white clothes, approached and held a gun. The place had a checkout counter.

witness_C.statement: I saw a woman behind the counter who was being robbed. I think she was playing with her mobile phone. A man in black robbed her; I'm pretty sure he put a bag on the table and threatened her with a gun. The weapon was held by the robber, but I'm not sure if it was a gun. The place had a checkout counter. Another man in a grey coat was just nearby, but I'm not sure what he was doing.
